choreo.doc: M2-BPR-01/02: battle choreography (docs/kb/tech/battle_presentation.md). BattleChoreo plays each resolved action as beats: approach (the actor travels), strike (the action's clip, or its procedural motion), contact (at strike start + contact_at x strike_sec: the target reacts, damage floats and hit VFX land), recover, return. A KO collapses ko.delay_sec after contact. All times are seconds at battle speed 1.0; distances are metres. travel: 'target' runs to stop_short_m in front of the target(s); 'step' steps step_m toward them; 'none' stays on the mark. lunge_m, lift_m, crouch_m and lean_deg shape the procedural strike on a stand-in with no clip.

dive.doc: M2-BPR-04 Lamp Dive (Rhen): a leap that rises arc_m over the approach, then a plunge onto the target; contact on the plunge.

verse.doc: M2-BPR-04 Shallows Verse (Asha): a chant held long; every healed ally lifts in turn, stagger_sec apart.

brace.doc: M2-BPR-04 Return Tide (Toma): planted, he takes the tide (windup_m back and down at windup_at), then answers it with one counter thrust.

glyph.doc: M2-BPR-04 Written Light (Ysolde): a glyph written in the air, trace_strokes strokes side to side, finished on the contact; the light reaches each foe in turn.

toll.doc: M2-BPR-04 the Drownbell's Toll: the bell rears back (windup_m) and lurches down on the toll; every party member recoils hard (react_scale) as the shockwave reaches it (wave_m_s: BattleBossVfx's ring, boss_vfx.json toll (ring_radius_m - 0.2) / ring_s).

reaction.doc: The target's reaction on the contact beat. damage: recoil_m away from the actor and tilt_deg back, out and back over sec; heal: a lift_m rise; miss: a sidestep of dodge_m. clip names the model clip tried first (the clip contract).

enter.doc: A fighter swapped or called in walks onto its mark from back_m behind it.

choreo.accent_doc: M2-BPR-04 accents (BattleChoreo.accent): a short overlay on a fighter's root, out and back over sec. lift_m/crouch_m up/down; recoil_m and tilt_deg back, away from the other side (negative leans in); sway_deg side to side, sways times; clip (optional) a contract clip.

bosses.doc: M2-BPR-04 BattleBossChoreo, by enemy row id. charge_skill: the charge whose gather sways the boss (on the gathering action's contact, then each turn of the charge); break: the boss's stagger on the rim-breaking blow's contact; flood: on phase_changed to phase, the party braces in slot order (stagger_sec apart) once the action playing is done. The toll's own motion is the 'toll' style.

vowbound.doc: M2-BPR-04 BattleVowboundChoreo. call: the caller's accent as it calls; step_off: the party walks back off the field in slot order (delay_sec + stagger_sec x slot); entry: the Vowbound rises depth_m out of the water at its slot after delay_sec, tipped lean_deg forward and straightening (longer than a swap's walk-in); dismiss: it sinks back (after the action playing, a battle won included); fall: struck down, it takes the blow, then tips back tilt_deg and is drawn under, slower; return: the party walks back in (choreo enter) once share of the exit has played, stagger_sec apart.

reduced_motion.doc: UiSettings reduced motion: shorter travel and leans, no tilt on reactions.

speeds.doc: UiSettings battle_speed values (accessibility.json) the sequencer accepts.
